title: NEW IN CARD NAMES YOUR BUILD
why: his order 10-27: he read v0.1137 off the new in card while playing v0.1149 and took it for an old build; the menu now shows one version number
now: the new in card shows the build you play

edits.replacement: ctx.fillText('NEW IN '+verShown(VER),wnX+LH(22),wnY+LH(32));   // v35.xx (cw-newinver), HIS ORDER (2026-10-27): he read v0.1137 off this card while playing v0.1149 and took it for an old build ("nope the main PC ... is serving v0.1137"). The card names the build he plays, so the menu shows one version number. WHATSNEW_VER still stamps the list and decides when the card is new.
if(S) S.textContent='NEW IN '+verShown(VER);   // v35.xx (cw-newinver): the build he plays, like the floor card (WHATSNEW_VER read as an older build)
